description: Balancing energy prices components per minutes (Historical as of 22/05/2024) is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. Prices of the components used to calculate the imbalance price per minute. At the specified time, the most recent available data are collected and displayed as quickly as technically possible. All published values are non-validated values and can therefore only be used for information purposes. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Balancing. Its keywords are Activation. The portal shows 2025-06-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
